##### Project general facts

Pristine by Zoya is a low-density residential building with a podium level, typical residential floors and a rooftop amenity deck. The architecture takes a blank-canvas approach with an emphasis on generous proportions, including ceilings higher than the market norm and full-height window walls that maximise natural light. Residences include one- and two-bedroom apartments and podium-level three-bedroom apartments with private plunge pools and gardens, with Vastu principles in selected units, a grand entrance lobby and a corner-plot orientation.

Residents enjoy a comprehensive amenity programme across the podium and rooftop levels, including adult and kids' swimming pools, an outdoor poolside cinema, a mini golf course, an outdoor yoga deck, a barbecue area, a co-working space, a sports room, a gaming room, a reception lounge and a dedicated kids' play area. Wellness facilities include a panoramic gym and separate saunas, while round-the-clock security and concierge, a residents' shuttle, integrated retail outlets, solar-powered common areas, EV charging stations, bicycle racks, standard smart-home integration and a pet-friendly policy complete the offering.

Interiors follow a light, contemporary palette shaped around high ceilings, floor-to-ceiling window walls and open-plan flow. Custom-crafted wardrobes with walk-in closets, a separate laundry room, ensuite bathrooms for every bedroom plus a powder room, and pre-wiring for high-speed internet, phone and satellite TV come as standard. Oslo Marfil and Latina Grey flooring, Parama Walnut laminate joinery, engineered quartz surfaces, Siemens kitchen appliances and Jaquar bathroom fittings define the finishes, with residences delivered with fully equipped kitchens.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a residential community located close to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR) and other popular areas of Dubai. It combines villas and apartment buildings, offering a diverse range of housing options for residents.

The community is known for its well-planned infrastructure and a mix of Arabic, Mediterranean and contemporary architectural styles. Landscaped parks, playgrounds, fitness centres, swimming pools, sports courts and cycling and jogging tracks enhance everyday life, while retail centres within the community provide convenient access to shopping, dining and essential services.

Al Furjan's family-friendly environment, metro connectivity and established amenities make it a sought-after address for end users and investors looking for steady rental demand in Dubai.
